instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Management consulting firm serving mid-market companies with strategy, operational excellence, and digital transformation engagements. Team of 40 consultants across 3 offices. Typical engagements are 8-16 weeks. Evaluating knowledge management AI to capture and surface past engagement insights for proposal development. The company has mature core business processes but struggles with the tension between running the existing operation efficiently and carving out resources for innovation. We have pockets of digital maturity in specific teams while other areas rely heavily on manual workflows and spreadsheets.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: Our board has set an ambitious revenue target of reaching €50M ARR within 5 years from our current base. This requires us to expand our addressable market, potentially pivot pricing models from one-time to recurring revenue, and build a repeatable enterprise sales motion. We need to identify the highest-leverage growth levers without overextending our cash runway.
answers.teamSize: The technology organization is structured into product-aligned squads with a central platform team of 5 engineers enabling shared infrastructure. Innovation is driven by a '20% time' policy where all engineers can dedicate one day per sprint to self-directed projects, plus a quarterly internal pitch competition where winning ideas receive seed funding and 3 months of dedicated squad allocation.

input.changes_since_last: Completed 4 strategic partnerships. Revenue growth 15% YoY. Exploring AI/ML capabilities.

opportunities.title: Knowledge Asset AI Layer for Proposal Engineering
opportunities.rationale: The firm has successfully demonstrated digital capability (onboarding flow) and needs to leverage this success internally. Implementing a knowledge management AI layer will capture deep engagement insights, accelerating proposal development and reducing reliance on manual memory recall, which is critical for scaling service delivery.

first_actions: Audit all historical proposals and project documentation to define data schema gaps.
Identify 3-5 high-frequency/high-value topics where AI summarization would provide immediate value (e.g., 'Cloud Migration Risk Assessment').
Pilot a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) prototype using the platform team's existing infrastructure.
resources_needed: Cross-functional Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) from delivery teams
Initial budget allocation for cloud compute/API services
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in proposal creation cycle time by 20% within 6 months.
milestones: Pilot successful on internal beta group (Q2)

opportunities.title: Develop Recurring Revenue Service Lines (XaaS Model)
opportunities.rationale: The strategic mandate requires a pivot toward predictable revenue streams beyond project-based consulting. This necessitates fundamentally rethinking service packaging from 'one-time delivery' to 'ongoing operational excellence as a service,' creating new pricing models and sales playbooks.

first_actions: Conduct financial modeling of converting the top 3 profitable, repetitive engagements into subscription/retention contracts.
Design a pilot proof-of-concept (POC) offering for recurring revenue, focusing on value predictability.
Revamp the sales team's training and incentives to prioritize long-term account retention over initial deal size.
resources_needed: Sales Leadership time (dedicating 20% of their bandwidth)
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 3 Letters of Intent (LOI) for recurring revenue streams, representing >10% of the next year's projected ARR.
milestones: Business case approved and financial model finalized (Q2)
Pilot sales motion tested with friendly client (Q3)
Internal pricing structure formalized across 5 key service lines (H2)

next_steps.action: Formalize a 'Revenue Model Workshop' involving Sales, Finance, and Product leads to define the recurring revenue playbook for Opp_2.
Establish a dedicated 'Innovation Sandbox' budget and physical allocation of resources within the central platform team to accelerate Opp_1 prototyping.
Conduct internal training sessions on the new cross-functional processes used in the digital onboarding flow to institutionalize best practices and combat process silos.

key_weaknesses: Structural tension between maximizing current operational efficiency vs. dedicating resources to high-risk innovation projects ('Run vs. Grow' dilemma).
Reliance on manual workflows and tribal knowledge in specific service lines, inhibiting scale despite digital victories.
Lack of formalized mechanism for cross-departmental accountability when complex changes require multiple functional buy-ins.

improvements: Successful deployment of a digital customer onboarding flow, demonstrably improving the customer experience and reducing time from 12 days to 5 days.
Enhanced innovation capacity through structured mechanisms (Product squads, '20% time' policy, pitch competitions).
Proven ability to execute large, cross-functional projects involving Compliance, Product, and Customer Success.
persistent_gaps: Difficulty translating initial digital wins into company-wide operational standards.
The gap between current service delivery (project billing) and the required future model (recurring ARR).
Maintaining focus on foundational infrastructure development while chasing immediate revenue targets.
achieved_milestones: Achieved 15% YoY revenue growth, validating market fit.
Significantly improved customer NPS through process optimization.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company has moved from early concept testing to proven operational execution (onboarding flow) and structural change (squad model). The strategic focus has sharpened significantly toward achieving predictable ARR growth.
